reviews.text: We always bring our dog here. They are amazing. Appointments are a little difficult to get so book in advance and it will definitely be worth it. They take amazing care of our pup.
A  really nice grooming place to bring your dog,very friendly staff.
Super impressed with our girl’s haircut. Changed from a boutique groomer in the area who kept not doing what we asked. Will definitely be back!

I've been bringing Millie here for about two years. I've just picked her up from her grooming session and I honestly cannot praise the staff enough. The cut is just perfect. She got compliments the whole way home. I would HIGHLY recommend Woof 'n Ready. VIP treatment.

Woof n Ready are honestly the best groomers.

We’ve been going to them for a while now, and Maple and Toast are always so well looked after. They come back looking like little clouds every single time.

You can really tell how much care and attention goes into what they do, and how comfortable the dogs feel with them.

We 100% recommend them. They’re always busy for a reason, so if you’re thinking of booking, do it sooner rather than later.

Such a lovely team, we wouldn’t go anywhere else 🤍

Our puppy Eddie looks amazing after his visits to Woof n Ready! He is so well looked after and always leaves in a very happy mood after being pampered! The staff are so friendly and helpful, Eddie is always very excited to see them! - I highly recommend!

We've been bringing our two cocker spaniels, Molly and Teddy, here since 2021 and honestly couldn't recommend them more. The team are so gentle and caring with them. Both Molly and Teddy are always so comfortable there and absolutely delighted with themselves when we collect them. They always come out looking their best. We wouldn't go anywhere else!
Highly recommend Emma and the team @ Woof n Ready. We’ve been bringing our dog Russ here for the past few years and he’s always well looked after and looking sharp post groom. Thank you!
Thank you so much for looking after Willow. We understand it was a tricky groom due to her recent surgery and coat length. She looks amazing and is enjoying her newfound freedom! Cheers C.
Fantastic team, great service and amazing dog treat selection. Archie always loves his full groom and looks and smells like a million dollars. Highly recommended.

Great service, our doggo Wilson looks really neat after the grooming service. Most importantly, he came back home all playful after being groomed, which usually isn't the case. This gives me confidence that he was treated well there.
Don't recommend ..
Just had my Ollie groomed today.  So happy with the groom.  Staff lovely and do exactly what you ask.  I would highly recommend them.

Woof n ready is an amazing grooming salon,well located in the heart of Stepaside. The staff is caring and professional. The atmosphere is very warm and welcoming.
Charlie ( Pomeranian) is very anxious and nervous around other people and dogs. At least he was before he met Carolina. This lovely girl not only made him look gorgeous but took a great care of him. It’s clear how much Woof n ready love and take a great care for the dogs they work with.
Carolina, thank you so much! You treated Charlie like your own. You are a dog whisperer!
❤️🐶 🐾
The best place to take your pet to consent. ❤️
The guys here are fantastic at what they do, the place is always clean and tidy with a great selection of treats and accessories for for dogs too. Highly recommend.

Great service,I had my old lady Yorkshire terrier groomed today,the receptionist and the groomer listened to Muffins skin problem and groomed her accordingly,Muffin also got a new jumper and they were so helpful with size and fitting, would highly recommend woofnready,so caring and Muffin looks fabulous.

From the moment we called to book the team was warm, professional, and clearly passionate about dogs. Our pups came out looking absolutely adorable, clean, fluffy, and happy and it was clear they had been treated with kindness and care throughout the entire visit. Highly recommend!

Great service, our labrador Jackson is always sparkling and fluffy after his visits to Wood n Ready! And most important he is always happy to go back! Very friendly staff, easy to book and communicate with!
Had our  dog buddy groomed here today , he looks and smells amazing.  Such lovely staff aswell. Thank you for such a great service.
Just had Woof n Ready give our mini schnauzer puppy his first cut. Lovely to deal with and they did a superb job on our handsome boy. Highly recommend.
Our dog always so happy to see Emma and her colleagues he is well cared for and comes out looking really well!
Tupi, Guida and Quetza love it.
Very friendly calm and patient staff

Great place, Bobby our 1 year old Maltichon loves going here & always comes out looking gorgeous! Staff so good with him & so friendly, also nice range of dog toys, treats & accessories. Would highly recommend.
Absolutely delighted with Sammy's transformation after his 1st visit here and 1st proper groom at 9 months old. Before and after photos

I brought my 15-year-old dog here for grooming, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team was so attentive and understanding of his needs, especially since he usually gets stressed during grooming. I’ve tried many groomers over the years, but this was by far the best. He was calm and well cared for throughout. I’ll definitely be returning—highly recommend!

An amazing groomers! My Golden Retriever had become overwhelmed & apprehensive in previous busy groomers so was looking for somewhere new & calmer. Really impressed with the service here- Shauna looked after her so well, great communication throughout and gave her a lovely cut exactly as per the brief. My dog was so much happier and relaxed! Glad to have them nearby in their lovely new premises.
Amazing experience every visit! Our dog Stella bounces in the door to every appointment which shows the care that the team give to each dog. Already booked next appointment :)
Such a lovely groomers, couldnt recommend it more. Amazing and caring staff who always do a perfect job!
Wonderful place! My mini schnauzer has never looked better. Really quick no drama service with really really good attention to detail and stuck to the brief. Highly recommended 👌🏻 …
